newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan auto offers 250 mln B shr at HK$1.89 each.
newsitem.headline: Changan auto offers 250 mln B shr at HK$1.89 each.

text.p: China's Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its initial public offer of 250 million B-shares at HK$1.89 a share had been five times oversubscribed.
Crosby Capital Markets Ltd, China Merchants Securities Co, China Securities Co Ltd and J & A Securities (Hong Kong) Ltd were appointed underwriters, it said in a statement.
The automaker expected to list on China's Shenzhen Stock Exchange on or before November 8, 1996, it said.
The firm recorded a net profit of 220 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1995, Changan said, adding that the net profit for the first six months this year reached 82 million yuan.
